requestSearch.subtitle: Find a request, then inspect its configuration, response, timing and usage. Filters are retained in the URL.
requestSearch.tracesHint: Source: stored traces, subject to capture and sampling policies. No record does not prove a request never arrived. Switch to access logs with the same filters.
requestSearch.logsHint: Source: collected access logs; log collection must be enabled. Results are not merged with traces. Missing Trace IDs or traces prevent full request reconstruction.
requestSearch.invalid.range: Invalid time range. Select the start and end again.
requestSearch.invalid.status: HTTP status must be an integer from 100 to 599.
requestSearch.loadFailed: Request search failed. This does not mean there were no requests.
requestSearch.empty: No captured records match. Adjust filters or check collection settings.
